t: Colored cables form local networks. Red, green, blue, and yellow cables do not connect to each other, even when placed next to each other.
彩色线缆构成局域网络。红、绿、蓝、黄四种颜色的线缆彼此互不连通，即使相邻放置亦然。
Routing cables are different: they are used by Routers and Wireless Routers to link multiple controller networks together.
路由线缆用途不同：它专供路由器与无线路由器使用，用于连接多个控制器网络。
